preconditions.description: Number of cities is between 2 and 100,000.
Number of roads is between n-1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two different cities within the range.
There is at most one road between any pair of cities.

preconditions.expression: all(any(dfs(i, j, set()) for j in range(1, n + 1) if i != j))
preconditions.description: The graph is connected, meaning any city can be reached from any other city.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= num < 10**9 + 7 for num in output)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is within the range [0, 10^9+7).

postconditions.expression: all(min_path_number(i + 1) % (10**9 + 7) == output[i] for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: Each output number is the remainder of the smallest possible number modulo 10^9+7 for the corresponding destination.
